arguments.value: This agreement gives Technology Health, Inc. (THI) exclusive worldwide rights to certain patents and related patent applications owned by Marv Enterprises for products and methods related to COVID-19 treatment, replacing or extending prior licensing arrangements between Marv and Premier. In return, THI must pay Marv an upfront $20,000 already paid, cover about $80,000 in unpaid past invoices by July 20, 2020, reimburse ongoing patent prosecution and other IP costs, pay 5% royalties to Marv on sales or use of licensed products and related services, and also pay an additional 5% royalty to certain Premier shareholders until $40 million has been paid. If THI misses required payments, the license can revert to Premier or Marv, depending on the payment type. The agreement also sets up a joint venture between Premier and THI to develop COVID-19 treatment products, with THI funding specified R&D payments, while Marv has no direct role except possible consultation. The parties agree to confidentiality, no brokerage fees, Pennsylvania law and venue, and reimbursement of Marv’s legal expenses by THI.
